source.author: Kay Lousberg
source.note: Knight.glb from the pack's GitHub mirror (LICENSE.txt: CC0, Kay Lousberg). The rig carries every alternative prop; kept 1H_Sword + Badge_Shield, dropped 1H_Sword_Offhand, 2H_Sword and the Rectangle, Round and Spike shields. 27 of 76 clips kept (1H sword-and-shield set; ranged, 2H, dual-wield, spellcast, unarmed and lie-down clips dropped). Height 1.6 m: KayKit characters are chibi (head about a third of the body), so a 1.8 m adult scale makes the head read huge next to realistic props; 1.6 m keeps the helmet near a real head size.

source.author: Quaternius
source.note: Wave-1 row 64 named Quaternius Animated Man/Woman (poly.pizza, now behind a Cloudflare challenge). Substituted with Casual_Male from the Quaternius Ultimate Animated Character Pack (Nov 2019) on OpenGameArt: the best-modelled reachable clothed everyday man with clips in the same file (idle, walk, punch, hit, sit). It has no run clip. The 2017 Animated Human (OGA, has run) is a 1.6k-tri barefoot mannequin whose clothes live in a missing texture; Universal Base Characters (itch.io) are unclothed bodies with no clips in the file (they need the separate Universal Animation Library).

source.author: Kenney
source.note: Kenney ships the same character as FBX and GLB; this entry uses the FBX (same mesh, colour map and 32 clips). The long arm stubs are authored (Kenney preview and the OBJ show them) and reach about 7 cm below the soles when the arms hang: standing gesture clips keep the feet planted and allow that dip (sinkAllowed); moving clips use ground clamp; sit, drive and the wheelchair poses are lifted so the body rests on the ground plane (set their lift to 0 to seat her on a chair or wheelchair at the authored height); when she sits on the ground the arm stubs hang about 15 cm past the seat and cross the ground (sinkAllowed), as lifting her onto their tips would leave her floating. The FBX rest pose is a T-pose, so views use idle@0.

source.author: Kenney
source.note: GLB member with its Textures/colormap.png (all 32 clips are inside the GLB; no separate animation file). Matched to mini-female-a so the pair reads as one set: height 1.1 m (Kenney minis are chibi, the head is about 40 % of the body, so a real adult scale would make the head huge; 1.1 m keeps the head near real size), noon script with the same role pairs, faceted shading. The GLB rest pose is a T-pose, so views use idle@0. Ground: moving clips use ground clamp; sit, drive and the wheelchair poses are lifted onto the ground plane (set their lift to 0 to seat him on a chair or wheelchair at the authored height). The arm stubs of this character stay above the soles, so no clip needs sinkAllowed. The sprint and die clips are authored with real air time (bounding steps, a hop back before landing).

source.author: CoinCoin
source.note: Wave-1 row 3 named the Ultimate Animated Animals wolf (poly.pizza, behind a Cloudflare challenge; its Google Drive is quota-blocked). The reachable Quaternius wolf (Animal Pack Vol.2, OpenGameArt, CC0) has only Idle and Walking; this CC-BY wolf has a stronger silhouette and seven clips. Its clips are all named "Baked frames…" and were identified by eye. The howl and the crouch-and-pounce attack keep sinkAllowed: their long brush tail passes 16 and 24 cm through the ground while the feet stay planted, and lifting would float the whole wolf.
